errors.E_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND: No arbiter.json found. Run `arbiter init` to initialize.
errors.E_CONFIG_INVALID: arbiter.json is invalid after the requested changes.
errors.E_INIT_ALREADY_EXISTS: arbiter.json already exists in this directory.
errors.E_UPGRADE_PARSE: Could not parse current governance level.
errors.E_LOCK_RELEASE: Failed to release file lock at {path}.
errors.E_LOCK_SYMLINK: Lock path {path} is a symlink — refusing to create lock.
errors.E_LOCK_FOREIGN_HOST: Lock held by a process on a different host ({host}). Run `arbiter doctor --recover-lock` to manually release.
errors.E_LOCK_BUSY: arbiter is already running (PID {pid}, host {host}, cmd: {cmd}, age: {age}s). Run `arbiter doctor --recover-lock` to force-release if the process is gone.
errors.E_LOCK_PATH_ESCAPE: Refusing to release lock at {path} — path escapes outside the project root.
errors.E_LOCK_SYMLINK_UNLINK: Lock path {path} is a symlink — refusing to unlink. Remove it manually.
errors.E_LOCK_UNREADABLE: Cannot read lock at {path} — it may not exist or is not a valid arbiter lock. Check permissions with `ls -la {path}`.
errors.E_LOCK_PID_CHANGED: Lock PID changed: expected {expected} but found {found}. The lock was released and re-acquired between inspect and recover. Aborting.
errors.E_GATE_MUTEX_UNSUPPORTED: flock(1) is {detail} — the per-repo gate mutex requires util-linux flock (kernel-side release when the gate-exec supervisor is SIGKILL/OOM-killed; killing the Arbiter Node PID alone leaves that supervisor holding the mutex). Run the wave serially (--max-parallel 1, no mutex needed) or install flock. (ADR-103)
errors.E_NO_PLAN_ANCHOR: No active plan anchor found. Run `/task #NNN` to initialize a plan.
errors.E_WORK_NO_CONFIG: No arbiter.json found. Run `arbiter init` first.
errors.E_WORK_NO_PHASE: Cannot advance: no active task phase.
errors.E_PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED: Plugin not found: {name}. Check `arbiter configure --set plugins={name}` to enable it.
errors.E_CONFIGURE_NO_CONFIG: No arbiter.json found. Run `arbiter init` first.
errors.E_FS_ENOSPC: Disk full while writing {path}. Free up space and retry. Use `df -h` to check available space.
errors.E_FS_EACCES: Permission denied accessing {path}. Check file ownership and directory permissions.
errors.E_FS_EROFS: Cannot write {path} — filesystem is read-only. Check mount options.
errors.E_FS_EDQUOT: Disk quota exceeded while writing {path}. Free up space or raise your quota.
errors.E_FS_EPERM: Operation not permitted on {path}. Check immutable bit, SELinux/AppArmor, ACLs, or file ownership.
errors.E_FS_ENOTDIR: Cannot access {path} — a component of the path is not a directory.
errors.E_FS_EISDIR: Cannot access {path} — target is a directory, expected a file.
errors.E_FS_ENOENT: Cannot access {path} — the path does not exist. Check the path, or create the parent directory first (for example: `mkdir -p`).
errors.E_FS_EBUSY: Cannot access {path} — the file is busy or locked by another process. Close it and retry.
errors.E_FS_EMFILE: Cannot access {path} — too many open files. Close other files or raise the limit with `ulimit -n`, then retry.
errors.E_INIT_GITHUB_SETUP: Failed to set up GitHub Actions.
errors.E_INIT_GITHUB_UNAUTHENTICATED: --github was requested but GitHub CLI (gh) is not authenticated: {error}. No GitHub workflows or their 8 gates (ci-tiers, action-pins, workflow-perms, workflow-runners, workflow-sha-pinning, workflow-job-naming, pr-size-gate, merge-method-ff-only) were emitted. Run `gh auth login` (or set GH_TOKEN) and re-run `arbiter init --github`.
errors.E_UPDATE_GITHUB_UNAUTHENTICATED: --github was requested but GitHub CLI (gh) is not authenticated: {error}. No GitHub workflows or their 8 gates (ci-tiers, action-pins, workflow-perms, workflow-runners, workflow-sha-pinning, workflow-job-naming, pr-size-gate, merge-method-ff-only) were emitted. Run `gh auth login` (or set GH_TOKEN) and re-run `arbiter update --github`.
errors.E_INIT_UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE: Language is unknown: test naming and test pyramid checks cannot be configured. Re-run `arbiter init --language <lang>` with the project language; governance files were not generated.
errors.E_INIT_DIRTY_TREE: Working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash first, or use --force to override.
errors.E_TARGET_REQUIRED: --target is required. Specify L2 or L3.
errors.E_DOWNGRADE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Downgrade not supported. Edit arbiter.json manually and run arbiter update.
errors.E_GRACE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The grace period is implemented for L1→L2 only (ADR-028). To move to a higher level, run `arbiter configure --set governanceLevel=<L3|L4>` followed by `arbiter update`.
errors.E_NO_GRACE_PERIOD: No grace period to extend (none set or already expired).
errors.E_GRACE_LOG_MALFORMED: grace-log.json is malformed — delete {path} to reset extend history.
errors.E_INVALID_BOOL: {path} must be true or false — got: {value}
errors.E_INIT_WIN32: arbiter does not support native Win32. Install WSL2 and run arbiter inside it. Setup guide: https://docs.arbiter.dev/install/windows
errors.E_INVALID_LEVEL: Unknown governance level: "{level}". Valid: L1, L2, L3, L4
errors.E_INVALID_LANGUAGE: Unknown language: "{language}". Valid: typescript, java, kotlin, rust, python, go, multi
errors.E_TRAIN_SEALED: SEALED: {reason} — {detail}. Land this train (gate, push, one PR closing every id) before starting the next one.
errors.E_PR_NOT_MERGED: NOT MERGED — {detail} A PR is owned until it is merged.
